title: 5.13 More Food
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Name eight more foods and say what you like and want.
grammar_function: It is + food; It is a + food; They are vegetables; I like + food; He wants a + food.
prerequisite: 5.1 It is a + fruit, They are grapes; 5.2 It is + food; 5.5 I like; 5.6 He wants.
speaking_outcome: Say It is soup., I like soup., I like salad. and He wants a sandwich.
